text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.generate (prod, us-west) p99 latency breached 2m ago. Current p95=820ms p99=2.3s, error rate +0.4% — page oncall

jen (oncall): on it. pulling up traces. which route?

samir: looks like /v1/streaming/generate with JSON-mode/tool-schema parsing enabled (recent rollout). saw a spike aligning with deploy at ~1801233900.

raj: confirmed. tail-sampler shows many streams stuck in "waiting for next chunk" for >5s. appears preproc CPU is pegged on tokenizer-worker pods.

maria: customers? any reported P1s?

jen (oncall): Ops intake: 3 customers reported streaming stalls (one saw repeated 502s). Not full outage but SLOs hit for latency-based tiers.

samir: quick hypothesis: schema preflight + JSON-mode validation increased per-request preproc cost, preventing continuous batching and causing KV cache contention. p95 before deploy ~110ms, after ~820ms.

raj: grabbing relevant logs:
```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/preproc/tokenizer.log | grep "json-mode"
[1801233912] preproc: parse schema start (req=abcd)
[1801233913] tokenizer: tokenization 1.2s (template heavy)
[1801233915] preproc: waiting for kv-cache lock
```

maria: can we roll config toggle back quickly?

jen (oncall): yes. plan: 1) flip json-mode validation -> off for streaming route 2) scale preproc pool + restart tokenizer-worker on affected nodes 3) enable fallback small-model for requests > 8k tokens. Anyone object?

samir: +1. I'll flip toggle and monitor. doing a quick dry-run on a canary slot.

raj: I'm warming extra preproc instances (scale to +3). ps: autoscaler didn't kick because headroom calc was wrong for preproc CPU. creating manual burst.

eng-sre-bot: runbook step executed: scaled deployment preproc/streaming-worker by 3 replicas (requested by raj).

samir: flipping flag now:
```
# curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/toggles/streaming-json-validation -d '{"enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer redwood-op"
{"ok": true, "applied_at": 1801234005}
```

jen (oncall): good. monitor metrics (samir, raj) — watch p95/p99 and streaming chunk latencies. i will post updates to customer comms team.

samir: initial metric change: p95 dropped from 820ms -> 340ms within 30s of flip, p99 still elevated at 1.1s.

raj: after scaling, chunk queue length decreased. tail stalls reduced. p95 now 180ms, p99 420ms. looks like main mitigation is effective.

maria: customer impact update: support already told impacted customers we're investigating and expect improved latency in ~10m. no escalations so far.

jen (oncall): next steps: (a) keep json-mode off for streaming for 2 hours (b) collect slow traces and diffs vs pre-deploy (c) postmortem and change autoscaler headroom calc. assign followups?

samir: i'll own a detailed perf diff (preproc CPU profile + tokenization breakdown).

raj: i'll file an infra ticket to fix autoscaler thresholds and add a runbook step to force scale for preproc on similar rollouts.

eng-sre-bot: incident annotated: mitigation_start=1801234005, mitigation_action=config-toggle-off, scale-action=manual-scale-+3.

jen (oncall): handing off to samir for follow-through and to prepare a short incident summary for SE/CS. i'm done with active paging in 10m.

samir: ack — taking over. quick note: we should also review prompt templates that cause heavy tokenization (nested tool schemas + long default examples). early indicator: top 5 slow traces all include the same template file t-legacy-v2.

maria: can we add a defensive preflight to reject huge embedded examples in templates?

samir: yes, that'll be in the action items. for now recording immediate RCA hypothesis: increased per-request preproc work from JSON-mode validation + template-heavy tokenization => serialization of tokenizer workers => tail latency + streaming stalls.

jen (oncall): thanks team. Incident status: mitigated, customer impact reduced, continuing investigation. I'll update the rota and mark priority for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre-bot: resolved alert: streaming.generate p99 back under threshold (p99=380ms) at 1801234620. incident duration ~8m.

samir: logging follow-ups:
- ACTION-1: perf diff + tokenization flame graphs (owner: samir)
- ACTION-2: autoscaler threshold fix (owner: raj)
- ACTION-3: template sanitation rules + preflight limit (owner: maria)
- ACTION-4: add canary to json-mode rollout that measures preproc CPU and streaming chunk latency (owner: eng-platform)

maria: i'll draft the customer post-incident note with timeline and actions.

jen (oncall): handing off thread to samir as primary. if anything regresses ping @jen. closing active page.

samir: ack. I'll post the postmortem draft in #postmortems and link here when ready.

incidents-bot: incident updated: severity=sev2, status=mitigated, linked-tasks=4, close_after_postmortem=true
